name: cagara
description: Cagara language support: diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, references, symbols, and completion via `cagara lsp`

cagara.path.description: Path to the cagara executable; the extension runs `cagara lsp`. When empty, the server bundled in the extension is used if this build carries one, then target/release or target/debug in a trusted workspace, then cagara on PATH.

enumDescriptions: SQLite. No TRY_CAST and no LPAD, and CAST of a bad value yields 0 rather than NULL.
cagara.dialect.markdownDescription: SQL dialect to compile to when copying SQL. The names are the ones `cagara --dialect` accepts, and the choice is the same one the CLI makes: dialects differ in how Cagara's date, string and integer operations are rewritten, and a few cannot express some operations at all.

cagara.formatOnSave.markdownDescription: Format a `.cagara` file as it is saved, before the text is written. The language server sends only the lines that change, so the rest of the file keeps its tokens, folds and cursor. `Shift+Alt+F` formats without saving.

cagara.copyOnSave.description: Compile SQL and copy it to the clipboard every time a .cagara file is saved.

cagara.showSqlOnSave.markdownDescription: When SQL is copied on save, also show it beside the source. Off by default so saving does not move the editor; the clipboard is still filled either way. The "Cagara: Copy SQL" command always shows it, since running it is a request to see the SQL.

cagara.sqlPreviewFocus.markdownDescription: Move the keyboard into the SQL shown beside the source. Off by default: the cursor stays in the file being saved and the SQL appears without interrupting, in a read-only preview tab that wraps and takes a third of the window. Turn it on to put the cursor in the SQL as it appears, to search or select from it.

cagara.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments to pass to `cagara` when compiling, split on whitespace (e.g. `--pretty` or `--optimize`).

cagara.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the language server.
